{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Consulate''' of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eliad]] was located within the confines of the [[Eliad spaceport]] in the [[Jesart desert]]. It housed the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]], as well as a eight hundred strong [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] unit. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]] Eliad was ruled from here.
